title: Reviewing a supplier quotation
summary: What to verify before a quotation is treated as comparable, complete and ready for a commercial decision.
contentNotice: Demonstration content for Atlas interface development; not final MOSCATELLI policy.

blocks.text: Confirm material, dimensions, quantity, currency, taxes, shipping assumptions, sample costs, lead time and payment terms before comparing quotations.

items: Material and specification match the brief
Currency and tax basis are clear
Sampling and tooling costs are separated where relevant
Freight, Incoterms or delivery assumptions are stated
Lead time begins from a defined event

blocks.text: Two headline unit prices may not be comparable if one excludes tooling, finishing, packing or transport. Convert quotations into the same commercial frame before drawing a conclusion.

blocks.label: Commercial caution
blocks.text: The lowest unit price is not necessarily the lowest total cost or the lowest operational risk.

steps.title: Consolidate gaps
steps.text: Gather missing or ambiguous points into one clear request.

steps.title: Reference the exact quote
steps.text: Use the quotation date or identifier so both parties are discussing the same document.

steps.title: Preserve revisions
steps.text: Keep the revised quotation rather than silently replacing the earlier commercial history.
